diagrams.title: **Two layers of interoperability
diagrams.caption: **Two layers of interoperability.** A2A connects agents to agents; MCP connects each agent to its tools and data. You'll build each layer in its own lab.

diagrams.title: **N × M becomes N + M
diagrams.caption: **N × M becomes N + M.** Each model connects to MCP once and each tool connects to MCP once. Adding a fourth model or tool adds one connection, not three.

diagrams.title: **A tangle vs a hub
diagrams.caption: **A tangle vs a hub.** Without MCP, agents maintain a separate integration for each tool. With MCP, one standard, reusable connection layer reaches all of them the same way.
